keyResults.locator: §3-4 (Sp(2N,Z) action, tetrahedral building blocks, and 2-3 Pachner mirror symmetry)
keyResults.statement: Associates 3d N=2 SCFTs T_M to triangulated 3-manifolds M via Sp(2N,Z) polarization transformations, where 2-3 Pachner invariance is SQED <-> XYZ mirror symmetry (the quantum dilogarithm pentagon).
keyResults.useForFolio: Physical 3d-3d foundation for QOU's Neumann-Zagier symplectic gluing and state-integral / 3d-index partition functions.
